hooks.command:
/bin/sh -c 'if common=$(/usr/bin/env -i GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1 /usr/bin/git rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir); then main_root="${common%/*}"; target="$main_root/harness/antigravity-hooks/dispatch.mjs"; if [ ! -f "$target" ] && ! /usr/bin/env -i GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1 /usr/bin/git -C "$main_root" cat-file -e HEAD:harness/antigravity-hooks/dispatch.mjs 2>/dev/null && [ -f "../harness/antigravity-hooks/dispatch.mjs" ]; then target="../harness/antigravity-hooks/dispatch.mjs"; fi; if [ -f "$target" ]; then if result=$(node "$target" '''PreToolUse'''); then if [ -n "$result" ]; then printf '''%s
''' "$result"; exit 0; fi; fi; fi; fi; printf '''%s
''' '''{"decision":"deny","reason":"Antigravity 하네스 시작 실패: Git 또는 Node를 확인하라"}'''; printf '''%s
''' '''Antigravity 하네스 시작 실패: Git 또는 Node를 확인하라''' >&2; exit 0'
